Home.note: Replace null values with your home coordinates

office.note: Replace null values with your office coordinates

automation._note: Reading Find My steals focus, so the tracker stands down while the Mac is in use. Any input pauses it immediately; it resumes once the Mac has been idle this long. Set to 0 to disable.
automation._note_details: read_details: select each Find My row to harvest its street-level address (the list alone only shows the city). Adds ~3s per tab.
